admission.justification: Keeping dispatch as a fallback or accepting a broader unbound selection creates a second launch authority.

applicability: Unbound MCP role_start and the dashboard's parentless start selection.
conditions: Both use the same admitted selection table and role settings.
An Architect's start names no document argument; the durable sprint prose carries the request.
Unbound role_message remains refused and the started agent has no fabricated parent.
exclusions: No caller-chosen permission mode, pasted launch brief or alternative session primitive.

evidence: the tests named in found_at; record 32, section 2 (a chat without a role started an Architect on a real run); notes/reports/worker/a4868b83-d390-4b5e-9761-5097bcca689d/role-launch/260928-MIK-L113-repair-of-round-1-attempt-A2-37.md, section 2

statement: A `role_start` from a tool server without a binding is carried out by the dashboard's own start function under the same checks, for the selections of one table of what may be started without a parent; an Architect is started without a document, and `role_message` from such a server stays refused.
